name: EverQuote
verdict: WATCH / PASS as a conviction long — 4/10; the re-screen's mechanism survived but its CYCLE-DATING failed
entry_band: NOT a buy at $24.73 (+9% to FV, left-skewed, after a +78% re-rate off the April low). Optional ≤0.5% late-cycle momentum starter ONLY, laddered 23 / 21 / 18.50 — labeled honestly, never averaged. Cyclicals are bought at troughs; this is the peak.
kill_triggers: Progressive quarterly media-spend YoY turns NEGATIVE (the leading read)

court_record.dd: 4/10 WATCH — the DD refuted its own dispatching premise: (1) THE SPLICE: the re-screen's '102.7 -> 93.0 combined ratio' paired a P&C-TOTAL 2022 figure with a PERSONAL-AUTO 2025 figure — two series drawn as one line; the honest personal-auto series (112.2 -> 104.9 -> 95.3 -> 92.7E trough-2025 -> 97.1E-2026 -> >100 by 2028) says profitability PEAKED in 2025, dating the ad-spend top to ~NOW and the roll to late-2026/2027; (2) the tells: 42 carriers filing rate DECREASES, State Farm cutting across 40 states, Progressive's spend growth bending (+86 -> +35 -> +10 -> +20), and EVER's OWN sequential plateau (195.3 -> 190.9 -> ~190 guided) with the +21% YoY headline an easy-comp artifact; (3) concentration BRUTAL: top customer 38% of revenue, top-2 ~49%, auto 91% — the 2023 trough was partly ONE carrier's subsidy cut; (4) slowest-growing of the four aggregators (LTREE +37 / QNST +28 / MAX +17 / EVER +15) = share shifting away; (5) TCPA overhang genuinely RESOLVED (11th Cir. vacatur, FCC deletion) — the one clean de-risk; (6) the Feb -45% was the Insurify-ChatGPT AI shock, not the guide — healed in price, unresolved in fact; (7) insiders: net sellers, nobody bought the dip; (8) 7.6x = the PEAK-EARNINGS CRASH-CHEAPNESS distortion from the GARP trap catalog — normalized-spend EBITDA puts it at 9-10x, not cheap.
court_record.adjudication: Persisted as WATCH at the presiding desk. The blue-team-all-WAITs rule is honored via instruments, not another bench: this is a cycle-TIMING pass on a peak-cycle cyclical (not a TINA price-gate on quality), the ladder IS the taxonomy response, the missed-entry ledger grades the pass vs SPY, and the frozen cycle-top call grades the reasoning itself.

catalyst_overlays.event: personal-auto rate-filing cycle / carrier ad budgets
catalyst_overlays.call: the frozen sequential-plateau call grades it

edge_explainer.market_believes: The carrier ad-spend recovery has quarters to run — 80% of top carriers are still below peak spend.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The recovery already happened: insurer profitability peaked in 2025, rate CUTS are spreading, and EverQuote's own revenue has been flat for three quarters under an easy-comp headline. The stock is cheap on peak earnings — the classic trap our catalog exists to name.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Cycle-dating discipline: pairing the ad-spend lag with the rating agencies' combined-ratio forecasts instead of management's runway claim.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: The Street already reset targets to the mid-$20s — the market half-knows.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: ~Aug-3 print: sequential revenue above ~$195M = cycle still climbing (we're wrong); another flat quarter = top confirmed. Progressive's Q2 media-spend disclosure leads it.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: A broad-based (non-top-5) carrier spend wave extending the runway into 2027 with EVER re-accelerating sequentially.
edge_explainer.edge_type: the pass IS the position; graded by the frozen call + the missed-entry ledger
